model LineOverheadRate @@map("app_line_overhead_rate"); /// OH V1 overhead rate store (TASK-2853, Pack BOM v3 handoff O1): the plant overhead rate R, $ CAD per charged line-hour, indirect overhead only (never crew). Not on RateSettings, which is one row with no history. Append-only (a contract on the writer; no trigger enforces it): every save INSERTs a row, a same-day correction included; nothing UPDATEs or DELETEs one. So there is deliberately NO unique key on (lineNumber, effectiveFrom). Resolution for a line at a pricing date: (lineNumber, latest effectiveFrom <= date, latest createdAt), then line 0, then missing. No shift column: a second shift carries the same rate. SQL-only CHECKs (migration 20261014121000_task_2853_line_overhead_rate): line_number >= 0; rate_per_line_hour finite and > 0; inputs is a JSON object; created_by_id and created_by_email not blank. Nothing reads or writes this table yet: the store helpers and the /mrp/overhead-rates admin page follow in their own PRs.; line_number: /// 0 = plant default (V1 writes only line 0). No line master: lines are integers.; rate_per_line_hour: /// R. Deliberately no `overheadPer*` prefix: lib/costing/rate-masters.ts reads any key with that prefix as the per-operator-hour rate.; inputs: /// Immutable sizing snapshot at save: period, budget, pool note, working days and their source, each line's shifts and utilization, 7.5 h, normal hours, suggested R, entered R, look-back figures with their source.; override_note: /// Required by the writer when R differs from the suggested R by more than 5 %.; created_by_id: /// Bare actor stamps (no relation), as on LineActionSetupStandard.
